title: The Switched Trophy at Platform Nine
intro: The gleaming Golden Whistle, the prize for the station's model train contest, has been swapped for a painted fake inside the waiting room.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was checking the departure board all morning.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: My train was late, so I sat and read.

suspects.name: Mara
suspects.line: I only came to see the trains, honestly.

suspects.name: Rudy
suspects.line: Ask the ticket office, I was busy there.

clues.text: A commuter's ticket stub shows the culprit arrived on the local shuttle, so the trophy thief came in on that line and not by express.
The clerk's camera shows the culprit was not at the ticket office counter at the time of the swap, clearing that spot entirely.
Fine fibres of a glove were caught on the tap, showing the culprit worked with gloved hands and left no fingerprints on the trophy.
The shopkeeper's log proves the culprit was never inside the model shop that afternoon, so that shop can be crossed off the list.
